Card Q&A.a: 3 cards. In this case, there are 3 colors (red, blue, and yellow) in your opponent's Digimon and Tamers, therefore you trash 3 cards from the top of your deck.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has 1 red and blue Digimon and 1 red and yellow Tamer in their battle area. How many cards do I trash from the top of my deck when this card's inherited effect activates?

Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] For each color your opponent's Digimon and Tamers have, trash the top card of your deck.
